premise: Tree is ticklish; Squirrel and Raccoon try to climb him without tickling, but every step sets him giggling, until he laughs so hard his gold autumn leaves come down in a shower.
inspiration: Folk laughing-tree and giant-with-a-secret motifs, turned: the giant's weakness is a giggle, and the leaf shower is a treat for everyone.
lesson: Letting go can be the funniest thing that happens all year.
learning: In autumn leaves turn gold and fall from the trees.

en-US.title: The Ticklish Tree
en-US.text: It was autumn, and Tree's {tree:pulse} leaves had turned gold. And Tree had a secret. [whispers] He was ticklish. Squirrel {squirrel:hop} and Raccoon {raccoon:hop} wanted to climb up and see. Squirrel put one paw on the bark. {tree:wobble 0.4} {sfx:rustle} Hee. Raccoon put one paw on the bark. {tree:wobble 0.6} Hee hee. [giggles] Two more paws. Hee hee hee! The whole tree shook. Sorry! said Squirrel. Keep going, said Tree. I can hold it. Up they went, paw by paw. Hee. Hee hee. Mouse {mouse:hop} came out to watch. HEE HEE HEE! [laughs] Tree could not hold it. He laughed so hard that every gold leaf let go at once. {tree:shake 0.8 1.5s} {sfx:leaves solo} Down they came, like a golden rain. Squirrel {squirrel:spin} spun in it. Raccoon {raccoon:sparkle} caught them. Mouse vanished under a pile and came up wearing three. [happily] Tree stood there, bare and giggly. That is how my leaves come down, he said. Every autumn.

es-ES.title: El árbol con cosquillas
es-ES.text: Era otoño, y las hojas de Árbol {tree:pulse} se habían puesto doradas. Y Árbol tenía un secreto. [whispers] Tenía cosquillas. Ardilla {squirrel:hop} y Mapache {raccoon:hop} querían subir a verlas de cerca. Ardilla puso una pata en la corteza. {tree:wobble 0.4} {sfx:rustle} Ji. Mapache puso una pata en la corteza. {tree:wobble 0.6} Ji, ji. [giggles] Dos patas más. ¡Ji, ji, ji! El árbol entero tembló. ¡Perdón!, dijo Ardilla. Seguid, dijo Árbol. Aguanto. Subieron, pata a pata. Ji. Ji, ji. Ratón {mouse:hop} salió a mirar. ¡JI, JI, JI! [laughs] Árbol no pudo aguantar más. Se rio tan fuerte que todas las hojas doradas se soltaron a la vez. {tree:shake 0.8 1.5s} {sfx:leaves solo} Cayeron como una lluvia de oro. Ardilla {squirrel:spin} giró en medio. Mapache {raccoon:sparkle} las cogió al vuelo. Ratón desapareció bajo un montón y salió con tres puestas. [happily] Árbol se quedó allí, sin hojas y con la risa floja. Así caen mis hojas, dijo. Cada otoño.

rustle.prompt: a tree's leaves rustling in a quick giggly shiver, light and playful

leaves.prompt: a whole tree's dry golden leaves letting go at once and showering down softly onto the ground
